mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT(awc.`name`,':',awc.`start_work_time`, '-' , awc.`end_work_time`) AS `classesName`, cc.`clock_date`, cc.`start_work_time`, cc.`end_work_time`, cc.`start_real_time`, cc.`end_real_time`, cc.`start_work_clock_time`, cc.`end_work_clock_time`, cc.`start_work_clock_status`, cc.`end_work_clock_status`, cc.`classes_clock_status`, cc.`start_trigger`, cc.`end_trigger` FROM `classes_clock` cc LEFT JOIN `arrange_work_classes` awc ON cc.`arrange_classes_id` = awc.`id` WHERE cc.`clock_date` = #{clockDate} AND cc.`user_id` = #{userId}

SELECT * FROM `classes_clock` WHERE `deleted` = 0
and `user_name` like CONCAT('%',#{param.keyword},'%')
and `user_dept_id` = #{param.userDeptId}
and `clock_date` between DATE_FORMAT(#{param.period.begin},'%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(#{param.period.end},'%Y-%m-%d')
and `tenant` = #{tenant} ORDER BY `clock_date` DESC,`user_name` ASC -- ,CONVERT(user_name USING gbk) ASC

SELECT a.`user_id`, a.`user_name`, a.`user_dept_id`, a.`work_id`, a.`attendance_group_id`, b.`classes_id` as `arrangeClassesId`, a.`clock_date`, a.`start_work_time`, a.`end_work_time`, a.`start_real_time`, a.`end_real_time`, a.`start_work_clock_time`, a.`end_work_clock_time`, a.`start_work_clock_status`, a.`end_work_clock_status`, a.`classes_clock_status`, a.`start_leave`, a.`end_leave`, a.`start_trigger`, a.`end_trigger` FROM `classes_clock` a INNER JOIN `arrange_work_classes` b ON a.`arrange_classes_id` = b.`id` where a.`clock_date` <= #{endDate} and a.`clock_date` >= #{startDate} and a.`user_id` = #{userId} order by a.`clock_date`
